# eci_region (Data Source)

Provides information about an ECI region (e.g., `central-01`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eci_region" "central" {
  name = "central-01"
}

data "eci_zone" "zone_a" {
  name      = "central-01-a"
  region_id = data.eci_region.central.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) human-readable name of the region

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) unique identifier of the region
